en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large historic building with a central tower and smaller corner turret, likely an inn or villa, set along a tree-lined road. The architecture has ornate windows, a veranda on the left side, and steps leading to an arched entrance. In the distant right background a tower-like structure is visible. At the top of the card, printed in red Gothic-style lettering, are the words identifying the location.
